name: Bjorn Svensson
bio:
Bjorn Svensson’s journey into motorsport began with a fascination for rally racing, a passion ignited during his youth in the snow-covered landscapes of northern Sweden. After completing his engineering degree at the Royal Institute of Technology in Stockholm, he initially worked in the automotive industry, honing his skills in vehicle dynamics and performance optimization. However, the allure of motorsport proved too strong, leading him to accept a position with a smaller racing team competing in the European touring car championship. 

Over the years, Bjorn has steadily climbed the ranks, earning a reputation for his meticulous approach to problem-solving and his ability to extract maximum performance from limited resources. He views his role as chief engineer as a combination of technical expertise and team leadership, fostering a collaborative environment where innovation thrives. What sets Bjorn apart is his unwavering dedication to the team's success and his knack for identifying subtle improvements that can make a significant difference on the track. 

He is known for his pragmatic, methodical approach, always seeking data-driven solutions and avoiding unnecessary risks. Bjorn is a firm believer in continuous improvement and constantly seeks to refine his engineering processes to gain a competitive edge. He is now a free agent, ready to bring his experience and loyalty to a team looking to elevate their performance.

physical.description: Bjorn is a tall, lean man with a focused gaze and a weathered face.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with technical diagrams.
Insists on drinking black coffee, even during the hottest races.
Has a habit of tapping his pen against his teeth when deep in thought.
